description: Legal Affairs Department - Ministry of Finance - Welfare Benefit Payment (Section of Persons Eligible to Receive Payment) Regulation No 1 of 2022
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the President under the Welfare Benefits Act, establishing procedures for welfare benefit applications, information systems, and selection committees. It focuses on creating a legal/regulatory framework for welfare benefit administration rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories. The content primarily deals with statutory instruments and regulatory procedures, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5).
